summary: A detection rule's zone (ZonePolygon) can now hold multiple polygons instead of just one: infra/vision gained parseZones/pointInAnyZone/boxCenterInAnyZone (motion.go) and every detector (motion, external-object, crowd, LPR, line-crossing) was switched to the multi-zone form, evaluated as a union — an object counts if it falls inside any configured zone. The value stays a JSON string, so a legacy single polygon [[x,y],...] still parses exactly as before; the multi-zone shape is a list of polygons [[[x,y],...],...]. To go with it, the mymatasan detection-frame drawing surface (previews.js) gained a floating Paint-style toolbox: select/add/delete zone tools, undo/redo, snap-to-grid, refresh-frame, flip H/V, center box, full frame, line-direction cycle, extend-to-edges, a movable palette, and keyboard nudge/delete, plus rubber-band 'Add zone' (drag a rectangle or click for a default box) to add each additional zone. Separately, the mymatasan Dashboard (previously an empty landing page) was rebuilt into an event-analytics view: a new GET /api/notifications/stats endpoint aggregates the unified notifications table in Go (works identically across sqlite/postgres/mariadb, no dialect-specific SQL) into KPI totals, category/severity/source/camera/label breakdowns, and a timeseries, rendered by a new dependency-free @shared/charts SVG module (StatCard/Donut/Bar/TimeSeries) with a Today/7d/30d range selector and live refresh off the same signal as the notification bell. Notification settings gained per-section save: PUT /api/settings/notification/destination and DELETE .../destination/{id} upsert/remove one delivery destination, and PUT /api/settings/notification/retention saves only retention, all via read-modify-write against the persisted settings so editing one section never clobbers another. The mymatasan/myseliasan side-nav was reorganized: the bottom Lock/theme controls were replaced by a slim account chip (avatar + role + ghost logout icon, no username/email shown) under the brand, and the theme picker moved to the top-right after the language switcher. mymatasan's first-run local admin seed now reads localAuth.username/localAuth.password from config (env LOCAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD still overrides the password) instead of a hardcoded admin/Admin123, falling back to admin/admin to match myseliasan's stock superadmin when config supplies neither; the seeded account is now always forced to change its password on first login. Finally, the shared controllers.SendError helper now reveals the caller-supplied detail message for any 4xx client-error response in every environment (previously only in ENVIRONMENT=dev) since a 4xx message describes the caller's own bad input; 5xx server-error detail still stays hidden outside dev.
compatibility: No DB migration for multi-zone: ZonePolygon remains free-form JSON text and every existing single-polygon rule keeps working unchanged. The Dashboard and destination/retention endpoints are additive; no existing route or stored settings shape changed, and old full-blob PUT /api/settings/notification still works. Existing mymatasan installs that already have a local user table are unaffected by the admin-seed change (it only runs on a genuinely empty user table); a brand-new install with no localAuth.username/password configured now seeds admin/admin instead of admin/Admin123, and — like before — the account is forced to change its password before it can be used for anything else. The SendError change is repo-wide and affects every app: any handler that already passed a detail message to SendError on a 4xx will now surface that message to callers in production, not just in dev; no handler code changes are required, and 5xx behavior (including in dev) is unchanged.
